title: Through the fog
description: A wet day on the road: a quiet bus stop, a fox at the verge, and deer in the long grass.

items.alt: A bicycle with covered luggage beside a wet road
A small wooden shed stands among broad green leaves beneath a foggy sky.
A bus stop and folding chair beside a wet road disappearing into fog.
A rain-soaked junction leads into fog between dense green shrubs.
A fox pauses beside a roadside fence with open grassland beyond.
A crow perches on a roadside sign above a fog-filled green valley.
Deer in a grassy valley beneath green hills
